exceptions.reason: Autorun worker contains process spawning (tmux sessions, Claude Code invocation), async timeout handling, and worktree lifecycle management that require real process infrastructure to exercise. 20 tests cover all testable paths via injectable trait mocks (TmuxProvider, ClaudeProvider, WorktreeProvider). The 280 uncovered lines are in run_worker() async execution, process output parsing, and cleanup-on-crash paths that cannot be unit-tested without spawning real tmux+Claude processes. Branch coverage 91.82% exceeds 85% threshold.
exceptions.remove_when: Integration test harness with mock tmux/Claude processes is implemented, or file is refactored to extract more testable pure functions

exceptions.reason: Line coverage 80%, branch coverage 85%. 68 tests cover all extractable pure functions and inner implementations. Remaining ~200 uncovered lines are structurally untestable: run_launch() calls exec(2) which replaces the process (cannot return to test harness); run_status/run_list/run_cleanup call detect_project_root() which requires real CWD with .git directory. Outer wrapper functions (sweep_stale_session_dirs, clean_session_worktree_map, mark_stale_worktree_entries) delegate to tested inner functions but are themselves uncovered because they construct paths from project_dir.
exceptions.remove_when: run_launch refactored to return a Command without calling .exec(), or detect_project_root made injectable

exceptions.remove_when: TUI event loop refactored to allow headless rendering tests, or integration test harness with mock terminal is implemented
